package main

// Opt-in recovery probe over the real Observatory handlers. This file is
// overlaid into a selected Fathom checkout; it is never written there.

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

const recoveryProbeLimit = 1 << 20

type recoveryProbeContract struct {
	Version  int    `json:"version"`
	Service  string `json:"service"`
	Expected struct {
		CallsTotal    int    `json:"callsTotal"`
		CallsAgent    int    `json:"callsAgent"`
		Configuration string `json:"configuration"`
	} `json:"expected"`
	Log struct {
		File   string `json:"file"`
		SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
	} `json:"log"`
	CacheTTLMillis       int `json:"cacheTTLMillis"`
	FreshCacheMaxMillis  int `json:"freshCacheMaxMillis"`
	RefreshWaitMillis    int `json:"refreshWaitMillis"`
	RecoveryWaitMillis   int `json:"recoveryWaitMillis"`
	PollMillis           int `json:"pollMillis"`
	BrowserTimeoutMillis int `json:"browserTimeoutMillis"`
	Control              struct {
		StatusPath     string `json:"statusPath"`
		TransitionPath string `json:"transitionPath"`
		TokenHeader    string `json:"tokenHeader"`
		RequestBody    string `json:"requestBody"`
		ContentType    string `json:"contentType"`
	} `json:"control"`
	Lanes []struct {
		Width  int    `json:"width"`
		Height int    `json:"height"`
		Theme  string `json:"theme"`
	} `json:"lanes"`
}

type recoveryControl struct {
	mu        sync.Mutex
	contract  recoveryProbeContract
	report    *handlerProbeReport
	token     string
	origin    string
	logPath   string
	backup    string
	logBytes  []byte
	staged    string
	changed   bool
	changedAt int64
}

func TestAppkitActualObservatoryRecoveryProbe(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("APPKIT_FATHOM_HANDLER_REPORT_ROOT")
	if !filepath.IsAbs(root) {
		t.Fatal("APPKIT_FATHOM_HANDLER_REPORT_ROOT must be absolute")
	}
	info, err := os.Stat(root)
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
		t.Fatal("APPKIT_FATHOM_HANDLER_REPORT_ROOT must be an existing private directory")
	}
	if entries, err := os.ReadDir(root); err != nil || len(entries) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("APPKIT_FATHOM_HANDLER_REPORT_ROOT must be empty")
	}
	contractPath := os.Getenv("APPKIT_FATHOM_RECOVERY_CONTRACT")
	contract, contractBytes := recoveryReadContract(t, contractPath)
	token := os.Getenv("APPKIT_FATHOM_RECOVERY_TOKEN")
	if !regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{64}$`).MatchString(token) {
		t.Fatal("APPKIT_FATHOM_RECOVERY_TOKEN must be exactly 64 lowercase hex bytes")
	}
	logBytes := recoveryReadPinnedLog(t, contractPath, contract)

	envRoot := hermeticObsEnv(t) // the sole permitted cache reset is inside this existing helper.
	logPath := filepath.Join(envRoot, "recovery-call-log")
	if err := os.Mkdir(logPath, 0o700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Setenv("FATHOM_CALL_LOG", logPath)
	if obsCacheTTL != 30*time.Second {
		t.Fatal("native Observatory cache TTL changed")
	}

	report := &handlerProbeReport{}
	defer recoveryWriteReport(t, root, report, contractBytes)
	base, ok := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("http.DefaultTransport is not standard")
	}
	transport := &allowlistedTransport{base: base.Clone(), report: report, hosts: map[string]bool{}}
	transport.base.Proxy = nil
	previous := http.DefaultTransport
	http.DefaultTransport = transport
	defer func() { http.DefaultTransport = previous; transport.base.CloseIdleConnections() }()

	registry := httptest.NewServer(recoveryRegistry(report, contract.Service))
	if err := transport.allow(registry.URL, "recovery"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.Handle("/", landingHandler(registry.URL))
	mux.Handle("/observatory", observatoryHandler(registry.URL))
	mux.Handle("/observatory/service", observatoryServicePage(registry.URL))
	mux.Handle("/assets/app.css", assetsHandler())
	control := &recoveryControl{contract: contract, report: report, token: token, logPath: logPath, backup: filepath.Join(envRoot, "recovery-call-log-before"), staged: filepath.Join(envRoot, "recovery-call-log-staged"), logBytes: logBytes}
	mux.Handle(contract.Control.StatusPath, control)
	mux.Handle(contract.Control.TransitionPath, control)
	ui := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		report.request(handlerProbeRequest{Scenario: "recovery", Surface: "ui", Method: r.Method, Path: r.URL.RequestURI()})
		mux.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	}))
	control.origin = ui.URL
	if err := transport.allow(ui.URL, "recovery"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		ui.Close()
		registry.Close()
		recoveryRefusedPort(report, "ui", ui.Listener.Addr().String())
		recoveryRefusedPort(report, "registry", registry.Listener.Addr().String())
		if len(report.Failures) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("recovery cleanup recorded failures: %v", report.Failures)
		}
	}()

	recoveryControlRefusals(t, ui.URL, control)
	recoveryRunBrowser(t, root, ui.URL, contractPath, contract, token, contractBytes)
	recoverySecondTransition(t, ui.URL, control)
	if len(report.Failures) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("recovery handler probe recorded failures: %v", report.Failures)
	}
}

func recoveryReadContract(t *testing.T, path string) (recoveryProbeContract, []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
		t.Fatal("APPKIT_FATHOM_RECOVERY_CONTRACT must be absolute")
	}
	bytes, err := boundedRegularFile(path, recoveryProbeLimit)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var c recoveryProbeContract
	if err := json.Unmarshal(bytes, &c); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if c.Version != 1 || c.Service == "" || c.Expected.CallsTotal != 3 || c.Expected.CallsAgent != 2 || c.Expected.Configuration != "not inspectable" ||
		c.CacheTTLMillis != 30000 || c.FreshCacheMaxMillis <= 0 || c.RefreshWaitMillis < c.CacheTTLMillis || c.RecoveryWaitMillis < c.CacheTTLMillis || c.PollMillis <= 0 || c.BrowserTimeoutMillis != 210000 ||
		c.Control.StatusPath != "/__appkit_recovery/status" || c.Control.TransitionPath != "/__appkit_recovery/transition" || c.Control.TokenHeader != "X-Appkit-Recovery" || c.Control.RequestBody != "recover\n" || c.Control.ContentType != "text/plain" || len(c.Lanes) != 4 {
		t.Fatal("recovery contract changed or is incomplete")
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, lane := range c.Lanes {
		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d/%d", lane.Theme, lane.Width, lane.Height)
		if seen[key] || lane.Height != 1000 || (lane.Width != 390 && lane.Width != 1440) || (lane.Theme != "light" && lane.Theme != "dark") {
			t.Fatal("recovery contract lanes are not the exact four owned lanes")
		}
		seen[key] = true
	}
	if len(c.Log.SHA256) != 64 || filepath.Base(c.Log.File) != c.Log.File || c.Log.File == "." {
		t.Fatal("recovery log identity is not a bounded sibling file")
	}
	return c, bytes
}

func recoveryReadPinnedLog(t *testing.T, contractPath string, c recoveryProbeContract) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(contractPath), c.Log.File)
	data, err := boundedRegularFile(path, recoveryProbeLimit)
	if err != nil || len(data) == 0 || !bytes.HasSuffix(data, []byte("\n")) {
		t.Fatal("pinned recovery JSONL is not a bounded regular newline-terminated file")
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
	if hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]) != c.Log.SHA256 {
		t.Fatal("pinned recovery JSONL hash mismatch")
	}
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(string(data), "\n"), "\n")
	if len(lines) != c.Expected.CallsTotal {
		t.Fatal("pinned recovery JSONL row count differs from contract")
	}
	agent := 0
	for _, line := range lines {
		var row struct{ Service, Surface, Tool, TS string }
		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &row) != nil || row.Service != c.Service || row.Tool == "" || row.TS == "" {
			t.Fatal("pinned recovery JSONL has an invalid or mismatched row")
		}
		if row.Surface == "agent" {
			agent++
		}
	}
	if agent != c.Expected.CallsAgent {
		t.Fatal("pinned recovery JSONL agent count differs from contract")
	}
	return data
}

func recoveryRegistry(report *handlerProbeReport, service string) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		op := "unknown"
		if r.Method == http.MethodGet && r.URL.RequestURI() == statusPath {
			op = "statusz"
		} else if r.Method == http.MethodPost && r.URL.RawQuery == "" {
			body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, registryBodyLimit+1))
			if err == nil && len(body) <= registryBodyLimit {
				switch {
				case r.URL.Path == listServicesPath && string(body) == listServicesBody:
					op = "list_services"
				case r.URL.Path == toolsListPath && string(body) == toolsListBody:
					op = "tools/list"
				}
			}
		}
		report.request(handlerProbeRequest{Scenario: "recovery", Surface: "registry", Method: r.Method, Path: r.URL.RequestURI(), Operation: op})
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		switch op {
		case "list_services":
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"services":[{"service":`+strconvQuote(service)+`,"symbol_count":1,"languages":["Go"],"path":""}]}}`)
		case "statusz":
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"services":[]}`)
		case "tools/list":
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"tools":[]}}`)
		default:
			report.check("recovery", "registry refuses unexpected operation", false, r.Method+" "+r.URL.RequestURI())
			http.Error(w, `{"error":"refused"}`, http.StatusForbidden)
		}
	})
}

func strconvQuote(s string) string { b, _ := json.Marshal(s); return string(b) }

func (c *recoveryControl) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.URL.RawQuery != "" {
		c.controlCheck("query refusal", http.StatusBadRequest, "query")
		http.Error(w, `{"error":"query refused"}`, http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if r.Header.Get("Origin") != c.origin || r.Header.Get(c.contract.Control.TokenHeader) != c.token {
		c.controlCheck("origin/token refusal", http.StatusForbidden, "auth")
		http.Error(w, `{"error":"forbidden"}`, http.StatusForbidden)
		return
	}
	if r.URL.Path == c.contract.Control.StatusPath {
		if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
			c.controlCheck("status method refusal", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, r.Method)
			http.Error(w, `{"error":"method"}`, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		c.writeStatus(w)
		c.controlCheck("status read-only success", http.StatusOK, "")
		return
	}
	if r.URL.Path != c.contract.Control.TransitionPath || r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		c.controlCheck("transition method refusal", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, r.Method)
		http.Error(w, `{"error":"method"}`, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	if r.Header.Get("Content-Type") != c.contract.Control.ContentType {
		c.controlCheck("transition content-type refusal", http.StatusBadRequest, r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
		http.Error(w, `{"error":"body"}`, http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 65))
	if err != nil {
		c.controlCheck("transition body refusal", http.StatusBadRequest, "read")
		http.Error(w, `{"error":"body"}`, http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if len(body) > 64 {
		c.controlCheck("transition oversize refusal", http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, "")
		http.Error(w, `{"error":"oversize"}`, http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge)
		return
	}
	if string(body) != c.contract.Control.RequestBody {
		c.controlCheck("transition body refusal", http.StatusBadRequest, "mismatch")
		http.Error(w, `{"error":"body"}`, http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	c.mu.Lock()
	if c.changed {
		c.mu.Unlock()
		c.controlCheck("second transition refusal", http.StatusConflict, "")
		http.Error(w, `{"error":"already transitioned"}`, http.StatusConflict)
		return
	}
	if err := recoveryStage(c.staged, c.logBytes); err != nil {
		c.mu.Unlock()
		c.controlCheck("transition staging failure", http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		http.Error(w, `{"error":"transition"}`, http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	if err := recoveryOwnedEmptyDir(c.logPath, c.backup, c.staged); err != nil {
		c.mu.Unlock()
		c.controlCheck("transition fixture refusal", http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		http.Error(w, `{"error":"transition"}`, http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	// Hold the real model cache lock only for the two renames: no reload can
	// observe a transient missing path and fall back to a real call log.
	obsCache.Lock()
	err = os.Rename(c.logPath, c.backup)
	if err == nil {
		err = os.Rename(c.staged, c.logPath)
		if err != nil {
			_ = os.Rename(c.backup, c.logPath)
		}
	}
	obsCache.Unlock()
	if err != nil {
		c.mu.Unlock()
		c.controlCheck("transition rename failure", http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		http.Error(w, `{"error":"transition"}`, http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	c.changed = true
	c.changedAt = time.Now().UnixMilli()
	c.mu.Unlock()
	c.controlCheck("one exact transition succeeds", http.StatusOK, "")
	c.writeStatus(w)
}

func (c *recoveryControl) writeStatus(w http.ResponseWriter) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	changed, changedAt := c.changed, c.changedAt
	c.mu.Unlock()
	obsCache.Lock()
	at := obsCache.at
	obsCache.Unlock()
	now := time.Now()
	age := int64(-1)
	atMS := int64(0)
	if !at.IsZero() {
		atMS = at.UnixMilli()
		age = now.Sub(at).Milliseconds()
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"cacheAtUnixMilli": atMS, "cacheAgeMillis": age, "transitioned": changed, "transitionAtUnixMilli": changedAt})
}

func (c *recoveryControl) controlCheck(name string, status int, detail string) {
	c.report.check("recovery", "control "+name, status >= 200 && status < 300 || status == http.StatusBadRequest || status == http.StatusForbidden || status == http.StatusMethodNotAllowed || status == http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge || status == http.StatusConflict, fmt.Sprintf("status=%d %s", status, detail))
}

func recoveryStage(path string, data []byte) error {
	f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err = f.Write(data); err == nil {
		err = f.Close()
	} else {
		_ = f.Close()
	}
	return err
}

func recoveryOwnedEmptyDir(logPath, backup, staged string) error {
	info, err := os.Lstat(logPath)
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("owned call-log fixture is not a real directory")
	}
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(logPath)
	if err != nil || len(entries) != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("owned call-log fixture is not empty")
	}
	if _, err := os.Lstat(backup); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return fmt.Errorf("backup target exists or cannot be checked")
	}
	stage, err := os.Lstat(staged)
	if err != nil || !stage.Mode().IsRegular() || stage.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || stage.Mode().Perm() != 0o600 {
		return fmt.Errorf("staged log is not exact regular 0600")
	}
	return nil
}

func recoveryControlRefusals(t *testing.T, origin string, c *recoveryControl) {
	t.Helper()
	request := func(method, path string, headers map[string]string, body string, want int) {
		r, err := http.NewRequest(method, origin+path, strings.NewReader(body))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for k, v := range headers {
			r.Header.Set(k, v)
		}
		resp, err := (&http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}).Do(r)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer resp.Body.Close()
		got := resp.StatusCode
		c.report.check("recovery", "control client observed "+method+" "+path, got == want, fmt.Sprintf("want=%d got=%d", want, got))
		if got != want {
			t.Fatalf("%s %s = %d, want %d", method, path, got, want)
		}
	}
	ok := map[string]string{"Origin": origin, c.contract.Control.TokenHeader: c.token, "Content-Type": c.contract.Control.ContentType}
	request(http.MethodPost, c.contract.Control.StatusPath, ok, "", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
	request(http.MethodGet, c.contract.Control.StatusPath+"?x=1", ok, "", http.StatusBadRequest)
	request(http.MethodGet, c.contract.Control.StatusPath, map[string]string{"Origin": "http://wrong-origin", c.contract.Control.TokenHeader: c.token}, "", http.StatusForbidden)
	request(http.MethodGet, c.contract.Control.StatusPath, map[string]string{"Origin": origin, c.contract.Control.TokenHeader: "wrong-token"}, "", http.StatusForbidden)
	request(http.MethodGet, c.contract.Control.TransitionPath, ok, "", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
	request(http.MethodPost, c.contract.Control.TransitionPath, map[string]string{"Origin": origin, c.contract.Control.TokenHeader: c.token, "Content-Type": "application/json"}, c.contract.Control.RequestBody, http.StatusBadRequest)
	request(http.MethodPost, c.contract.Control.TransitionPath, ok, "wrong\n", http.StatusBadRequest)
	request(http.MethodPost, c.contract.Control.TransitionPath, ok, strings.Repeat("x", 65), http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge)
	if c.changed {
		t.Fatal("refusal changed recovery fixture")
	}
}

func recoverySecondTransition(t *testing.T, origin string, c *recoveryControl) {
	t.Helper()
	before, err := boundedRegularFile(c.logPath, recoveryProbeLimit)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	beforeSHA := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(before))
	req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, origin+c.contract.Control.TransitionPath, strings.NewReader(c.contract.Control.RequestBody))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Origin", origin)
	req.Header.Set(c.contract.Control.TokenHeader, c.token)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", c.contract.Control.ContentType)
	resp, err := (&http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}).Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	c.report.check("recovery", "control client observed post-browser second transition", resp.StatusCode == http.StatusConflict, fmt.Sprintf("want=409 got=%d", resp.StatusCode))
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusConflict {
		t.Fatalf("post-browser transition = %d, want 409", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	after, err := boundedRegularFile(c.logPath, recoveryProbeLimit)
	if err != nil || fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(after)) != beforeSHA {
		t.Fatal("second transition changed recovered log")
	}
	backup, err := os.Lstat(c.backup)
	if err != nil || !backup.IsDir() || backup.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		t.Fatal("original unreadable fixture backup is not a real directory")
	}
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(c.backup)
	if err != nil || len(entries) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("original unreadable fixture backup is not empty")
	}
}

func recoveryRefusedPort(report *handlerProbeReport, name, address string) {
	conn, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", address, 750*time.Millisecond)
	if err == nil {
		_ = conn.Close()
		report.check("recovery", name+" listener refuses after cleanup", false, "dial unexpectedly connected")
		return
	}
	report.check("recovery", name+" listener refuses after cleanup", strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "connection refused"), err.Error())
}

func recoveryRunBrowser(t *testing.T, root, origin, contractPath string, c recoveryProbeContract, token string, contractBytes []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	script, module := os.Getenv("APPKIT_FATHOM_HANDLER_BROWSER"), os.Getenv("APPKIT_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE")
	if !filepath.IsAbs(script) || !filepath.IsAbs(module) {
		t.Fatal("recovery browser inputs must be absolute")
	}
	out := filepath.Join(root, "recovery-browser")
	if err := os.Mkdir(out, 0o700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Duration(c.BrowserTimeoutMillis)*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "node", script, origin, out, module, contractPath, token)
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}
	groupCleanup := "normal-child-exit"
	killGroup := func() error {
		if cmd.Process == nil {
			groupCleanup = "no-child-pid"
			return nil
		}
		err := syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
		if err == nil {
			groupCleanup = "killed-owned-process-group"
			return nil
		}
		if err == syscall.ESRCH {
			groupCleanup = "owned-process-group-already-gone"
			return nil
		}
		groupCleanup = "group-kill-error: " + err.Error()
		return err
	}
	cmd.Cancel = killGroup
	cmd.WaitDelay = 2 * time.Second
	stdout, stderr := &boundedWriter{max: recoveryProbeLimit}, &boundedWriter{max: recoveryProbeLimit}
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = stdout, stderr
	err := cmd.Run()
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		err = ctx.Err()
	}
	if err != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
		_ = killGroup()
	}
	exitCode := 0
	if exitErr, ok := err.(*exec.ExitError); ok {
		exitCode = exitErr.ExitCode()
	}
	childReceipt, marshalErr := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"exitCode": exitCode, "error": fmt.Sprint(err), "timedOut": ctx.Err() != nil, "groupCleanup": groupCleanup, "stdout": stdout.buf.String(), "stderr": stderr.buf.String(), "stdoutOverflow": stdout.overflow, "stderrOverflow": stderr.overflow}, "", "  ")
	if marshalErr != nil {
		t.Fatal(marshalErr)
	}
	f, receiptErr := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(root, "recovery-browser-child.json"), os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
	if receiptErr == nil {
		_, receiptErr = f.Write(append(childReceipt, '\n'))
		if closeErr := f.Close(); receiptErr == nil {
			receiptErr = closeErr
		}
	}
	if receiptErr != nil {
		t.Fatal(receiptErr)
	}
	if err != nil || stdout.overflow || stderr.overflow {
		t.Fatalf("recovery browser failed: %v", err)
	}
	var summary struct {
		Passed   bool  `json:"passed"`
		Cases    int   `json:"cases"`
		Checks   int   `json:"checks"`
		Failures []any `json:"failures"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(bytes.TrimSpace(stdout.buf.Bytes()), &summary); err != nil || !summary.Passed || summary.Cases != 4 || summary.Checks <= 0 || len(summary.Failures) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("recovery browser summary is incomplete")
	}
	data, err := boundedRegularFile(filepath.Join(out, "browser-report.json"), recoveryProbeLimit)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var report struct {
		ContractSHA256 string `json:"contractSHA256"`
		Origin         string `json:"origin"`
		Inputs         struct {
			Browser struct {
				SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
			} `json:"browser"`
			Contract struct {
				SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
			} `json:"contract"`
		} `json:"inputs"`
		Failures []any `json:"failures"`
		Cases    []struct {
			Theme  string `json:"theme"`
			Width  int    `json:"width"`
			Height int    `json:"height"`
		} `json:"cases"`
		Screenshots []struct {
			File   string `json:"file"`
			SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
		} `json:"screenshots"`
		Captures []struct {
			File   string `json:"file"`
			SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
			Phase  string `json:"phase"`
			Theme  string `json:"theme"`
			Width  int    `json:"width"`
		} `json:"captures"`
	}
	scriptSHA, scriptErr := boundedRegularFileSHA(script, recoveryProbeLimit)
	contractSHA := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(contractBytes))
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &report); err != nil || scriptErr != nil || report.ContractSHA256 != contractSHA || report.Inputs.Contract.SHA256 != contractSHA || report.Inputs.Browser.SHA256 != scriptSHA || report.Origin != origin || len(report.Failures) != 0 || len(report.Cases) != 4 || len(report.Screenshots) != 4 || len(report.Captures) != 20 {
		t.Fatal("recovery browser report is incomplete or unbound")
	}
	wantLanes := map[string]bool{}
	for _, lane := range c.Lanes {
		wantLanes[fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d/%d", lane.Theme, lane.Width, lane.Height)] = false
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, lane := range report.Cases {
		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d/%d", lane.Theme, lane.Width, lane.Height)
		if _, ok := wantLanes[key]; !ok || seen[key] {
			t.Fatal("duplicate browser lane")
		}
		seen[key] = true
	}
	for key := range wantLanes {
		if !seen[key] {
			t.Fatal("browser omitted contract lane")
		}
	}
	for _, shot := range report.Screenshots {
		if filepath.Base(shot.File) != shot.File || len(shot.SHA256) != 64 {
			t.Fatal("unsafe browser screenshot record")
		}
		digest, err := boundedRegularFileSHA(filepath.Join(out, shot.File), probeScreenshotLimit)
		if err != nil || digest != shot.SHA256 {
			t.Fatal("browser screenshot hash mismatch")
		}
	}
	wantCaptures := map[string]bool{}
	for _, lane := range c.Lanes {
		for _, phase := range []string{"before-fleet", "before-service", "immediate", "after-service", "after-fleet"} {
			wantCaptures[fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d/%s", lane.Theme, lane.Width, phase)] = false
		}
	}
	for _, capture := range report.Captures {
		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d/%s", capture.Theme, capture.Width, capture.Phase)
		if _, ok := wantCaptures[key]; !ok || wantCaptures[key] || filepath.Base(capture.File) != capture.File || len(capture.SHA256) != 64 {
			t.Fatal("invalid browser capture set")
		}
		digest, err := boundedRegularFileSHA(filepath.Join(out, capture.File), probeScreenshotLimit)
		if err != nil || digest != capture.SHA256 {
			t.Fatal("browser capture hash mismatch")
		}
		wantCaptures[key] = true
	}
	for key, found := range wantCaptures {
		if !found {
			t.Fatalf("browser missing capture %s", key)
		}
	}
}

func recoveryWriteReport(t *testing.T, root string, report *handlerProbeReport, contract []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	payload := map[string]any{"contractSHA256": fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(contract)), "checks": report.Checks, "requests": report.Requests, "failures": report.Failures}
	bytes, err := json.MarshalIndent(payload, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Error(err)
		return
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "recovery-http-report.json"), append(bytes, '\n'), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Error(err)
	}
}
